Solutions

View All Solutions

Service

Dr.Presso

Cobot from Doosan Robotics is Korea's No. 1 collaborative robot with outstanding safety and convenience,
and the combination with top-tier coffee machine allows it to deliver high-quality service up to par with luxury coffee shops while its intuitive interface allows easy maintenance.

Industrial

Palletizing

The palletizing solution is composed of cobot specializing in organizing goods onto pallets in logistics and
transportation sectors. Automated palletizing maximizes productivity and safety.

Training

Training Kit

Doosan Robotics Training Kit provides opportunities of becoming a certified cobot engineer.
It is the first step in understanding how to teach cobots directly and how to collaborate with operators.

내일부터 인천이 뜨거워집니다 🔧 제61회 전국기능경기대회가 8월 22일 인천에서 개막됩니다. 51개 직종, 1,677명의 선수들이 그동안 갈고 닦은 기술을 겨루는 자리입니다. 두산로보틱스 협동로봇은 이 대회에서, 기계분과 '산업용로봇' 직종의 경기용 공인 로봇으로 채택되었습니다. 이는 성능과 안전, 품질까지 두루 검증받은 결과로, 기술과 안전의 글로벌 표준을 제시해 온 두산로보틱스가, 이번에는 선수들의 무대 위에서 함께합니다. 땀으로 채운 연습 시간, 실패해도 다시 잡았던 티치펜던트, 그리고 오늘까지 이어온 꿈. 모든 선수들의 기량이 후회 없이 발휘되기를 진심으로 응원합니다. 그리고 이 대회에서 자라날 미래의 로봇 꿈나무들에게 - 여러분이 만들 다음 로봇 표준을 기대하겠습니다. 두산로보틱스가 열렬히 응원합니다! 👏 #전국기능경기대회 #두산로보틱스 #협동로봇 #숙련기술 #인천

Consent to the Collection & Use of Personal Information

Doosan Robotics collects users' personal information to facilitate effective communication and provide enhanced services.

Purpose of Collection and Use
 - To provide improved services to users and enhance website quality through service usage analysis
 - To respond to customer inquiries and provide services

Items of Personal Information Collected
 - Required items: Full Name, Email, Phone Number, Country, Company Name

Retention and Use Period
 - In principle, collected personal information will be promptly deleted once the purpose of collection and use has been fulfilled.
 - However, for service usage analysis and quality improvement purposes, information will be retained for three (3) years from the date of collection.

Right to Refuse Consent and Potential Consequences
You have the right to refuse consent to the collection and use of your personal information as described above.
However, if you do not consent, you may be restricted from using certain services such as catalog downloads or training applications.

Consent to Marketing Use (Consent to Receive Promotional Information)

Doosan Robotics requests your consent to use your personal information for marketing purposes and to send promotional communications in order to provide you with beneficial information.

Purpose of Collection and Use
 - To provide information on benefits and updates regarding Doosan Robotics products, services, and events
 - Marketing communications (email distribution)
 - Analysis of email open rates and link clicks, and monitoring/improvement of marketing activities

Items of Personal Information Collected
 - Full Name, Email, Phone Number, Country, Company Name

Retention and Use Period
 - From the date of marketing consent until consent is withdrawn
 - Consent to receive marketing information will be reconfirmed every two (2) years

Method and Content of Promotional Information Delivery
 - Method: Email
 - Content: New product announcements, event information, promotional offers, etc.
 - Frequency: Up to four (4) times per month

Right to Refuse Consent and Potential Consequences
You have the right to refuse consent to the use of your personal information for marketing and the receipt of promotional information.
Refusal will not affect your ability to use essential services such as catalog downloads or training applications.

How to Unsubscribe or Withdraw Consent
If you do not wish to receive marketing information, you may unsubscribe or withdraw your consent at any time by:

 · Sending an unsubscribe request to marketing.robotics@doosan.com
